content.comment_body: Whenever I update the VM mapping from the web server, I encounter an error stating there is a program difference between the PC and the [product_name] device when trying to go online again. To resolve this, I have to manually ensure the VM memory is synchronized on both the PC and the [product_name] device every time. Is there a way to fix this issue without always changing my values on the [product_name] device? Would inserting a Micro SD card into the [product_name] module help? Any guidance would be appreciated. Thanks in advance.

Unfortunately, there is currently no solution to this issue. It can be frustrating since you have to put the [product_name] device in STOP mode to download the program, and when using the web server to modify parameters, the software reports differences because the changed parameters cause a mismatch between the offline and online program.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are consistently facing challenges with keeping the virtual memory mapping in sync between PC and [product_name] devices when operating through the web server. Updating the VM mapping prompts errors about program mismatches, leading to manual work to realign values. This recurring issue is bothersome, especially since the device must be stopped for program downloads, and frequent parameter changes lead to mismatches.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek a reliable and automated way to synchronize VM mapping between PC and [product_name] devices without the need for continuous manual adjustments or error messages. They are looking for a lasting solution that simplifies the workflow and prevents unnecessary intervention.
